Via våra interna nätverk, projekt och åtaganden i globala och nationella industrier, erbjuder vi dig kompetensutveckling och engagerade ledare som stöttar just dig i din utveckling.

* Friskvårdsbidrag: Vi erbjuder ett årligt friskvårdsbidrag på 4000 kr.
* Föräldralön: Vi betalar upp till cirka 90% av din lön under den första tiden hemma.
* Trygg anställning: Våra konsulter anställs med kollektivavtal och försäkringar.

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

title: Software Engineers
description:
*MSAB is a global leader in digital forensic technology for mobile device examination and analysis. The MSAB vision is to empower every investigation with digital forensic solutions – for a safer world. A core value is to run an ethics-driven company with innovation and results. The sole focus of MSAB is on delivering high quality digital forensic solutions to collect, review, analyze and manage data. MSAB is a trusted partner to Law Enforcement, Defence Forces, Government Agencies and Forensic Laboratories in democratic countries throughout the world enabling them to investigate crime, gather intelligence, investigate fraud and fight corruption.* 




  





 To our new Stockholm office we’re looking for two engineers to join our Unicore team. You enjoy building systems that are not only functional, but also efficient, scalable, and thoughtfully designed. This is a chance to work with technology with a purpose – to create a safer world.
 



  





**The job** 




 At MSAB, the Unicore team is responsible for the core of our digital forensics platform, including UNIFY and the XRY file format (Core API). We’re now working on the next generation of UNIFY, and this is an opportunity to help shape it from the inside.
 



  





 In this role, you will work with core system development where performance and reliability are critical. You’ll be dealing with distributed systems and data-intensive workloads, contributing to architectural decisions with long-term impact, and exploring how to best leverage hardware such as CPU and GPU.
 



  





 Our current tech stack includes C99, C++20, and C# (.NET 8/10), along with gRPC, SQLite and PostgreSQL, running across both Windows and Linux environments.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 We believe you will thrive in this environment if you have a genuine interest in programming and problem-solving, and if you care about performance, clean design, and user experience. You likely enjoy systems engineering, think in terms of trade-offs, and prefer solving meaningful problems over fitting into rigid roles. An appreciation for simplicity and keeping dependencies lean will serve you well.
 



  





**Your Experience** 




 You will benefit from your experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, containerization with Docker, or cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure which is considered a plus.
 



 You will be part of a focused team working close to the core of the product, where your decisions matter and your code has real impact.
 



  





 Interested, or know someone who might be? Reach out or apply — we’d love to connect.
 



  





 There is much more to talk about, like values, our growth plans, technology choices etc., but we save that for the interview.
 



  





 Welcome to apply now!
 



  





 For more information about MSAB, please visit: http://www.msab.com
 



  





**What we can offer** 




 Create a safer world with us!
 



 As one of the world’s leading digital forensics companies, MSAB leads the way in pioneering advancements that contribute to making our world safer.
 



 Your work at MSAB will bridge the gap between technology and justice. You will be inspired to go beyond your comfort zone, and you will deal with challenging and meaningful projects. When you join us, you become part of a global team that aspires to create a safer digital future, one breakthrough at a time.
 



 We can offer you an exciting work environment, where we value being innovative, acting ethically and delivering results in everything we do while our customers' needs are at the center. We are proud to be a fast-growing international company with more than 20+ nationalities and we work with things that really make a difference.
 



 Every day at MSAB is an opportunity to redefine the future of digital forensics.
 



 Are you up for the challenge?

title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
description:
**About Wolt**
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

 Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world’s largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.
   

  

 We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You’ll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

* Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
* Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
* Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing user intent.
* Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, Product Managers and Analysts to turn scientific insights into reliable customer-facing products.
* Evaluate and apply state-of-the-art ML methods where they meaningfully improve recommendation quality, robustness or efficiency.
* Contribute to a high bar for applied-science practice through technical reviews, knowledge sharing and thoughtful experimentation.


 Our humble expectations
   

  

* You have substantial hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world problems and a track record of bringing models from development into production; a PhD with relevant applied research experience is equally welcome.
* You have experience with recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, personalisation, or closely related ML problems.
* You can independently turn an ambiguous customer or product problem into a well-scoped ML approach, make sound trade-offs and drive it to a measurable outcome.
* You are proficient in Python and experienced with modern ML frameworks and large-scale data processing.
* You understand how to evaluate ML systems rigorously, including offline metrics, experiment design and interpreting online results.
* You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross-functional partners.


 What we offer
   

  

 You will work on recommendation problems with direct, measurable impact on how customers discover relevant content. You’ll collaborate with experienced scientists and engineers across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt, learning from multiple recommendation systems while helping shape the next generation of the experience.
   

  

 Together with your lead, you will have the opportunity to create a personalised development plan that builds on your strengths and develops new capabilities.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

 Nexer Infrastructure, tidigare Sigma IT Tech, startade sin verksamhet 2018 och är specialister på kompetens inom drift, support och infrastruktur.

title: System Verification Engineer, Test Automation
description:
**Mission** 




 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
 



 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 As a System Verification Engineer, Test Automation, you sit at the boundary between our hardware devices and our software. You build the test infrastructure that automates verification of software updates on our instruments, so new software ships quickly and with high confidence in its safety, performance and compliance. You define the test methods for system-level verification, develop the system tests those methods call for, and then automate them.
 



 You'll join the Verification & Validation team, which supports a wide regulated product portfolio spanning hardware medical devices (instruments), SaMD and health software. The team is small, growing and fast-moving, with real room to shape engineering quality, verification strategy, and how products are built as we scale.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, implement and maintain automated test frameworks and test rigs that exercise firmware and embedded software against the device hardware, sensors and instruments they control, and integrate them into the development and release pipelines.
* Build the tooling and pipelines that verify software updates on our instruments automatically, so new software deploys fast and with high confidence.
* Define test methods and acceptance criteria for system-level verification of our medical devices.
* Plan and execute verification activities, system and regression tests, and produce audit-ready reports.
* Contribute to traceability matrices, V&V plans and design reviews.
* Collaborate closely with Firmware, Electronics, Algorithms, Software, QA/RA and Manufacturing Engineering to make requirements testable and to debug failures across hardware, firmware and software boundaries.
* Ensure verification activities comply with Neko's SOPs and applicable regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, EU MDR).
* Continuously improve verification processes, infrastructure and tooling, both in scope (more devices, more coverage) and in quality (faster feedback, less flakiness, clearer reports).



  





**About You** 



* Automation you built yourself: 5+ years in system-level test and verification of complex hardware-software products, with a track record of developing tests and building test frameworks, test rigs including hardware-in-the-loop and physical stimulus setups, instrument control and fixtures, and integrating them into CI and release pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins or equivalent).
* Strong hands-on Python, for test automation, test framework development, tooling and data analysis.
* Enough embedded depth to work at the boundary: working knowledge of embedded systems and common protocols (UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, USB, Ethernet), and C and C++ at a level that lets you understand and instrument the firmware under test.
* Debugging across the stack: comfort debugging across hardware, firmware and software with oscilloscopes, JTAG/SWD debuggers and protocol sniffers.
* From requirements to test methods: turning requirements and product specifications into test methods, verification strategies and acceptance criteria.
* A degree in a relevant technical field: Electrical, Embedded, Software or Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics or similar.



  





**Nice To Have** 



* Verification that stands up in an audit. Experience from a regulated development process, and documentation habits that produce records an auditor can follow, in clear and structured English. Medical devices, automotive, robotics, industrial automation or another regulated hardware industry all count.
* Owning a test automation platform shared by more than one team or product line.
* Verifying devices that combine optics, sensors, custom electronics and embedded software.
* Setting up reporting and dashboarding for continuous verification (results, coverage, traceability) inside build pipelines.
* Shell scripting (Bash) and infrastructure-as-code / YAML pipeline definitions.
* Contributing to FDA submissions, EU MDR technical files or Notified Body audits.



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Neko's device portfolio is growing faster than manual verification can scale. As a System Verification Engineer, Test Automation you build the automated verification backbone that lets our instruments be updated safely, quickly and with confidence, across every clinic and every country we operate in.

title: Director of ML Engineering - Conversation Product Area
description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
   

  

 Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.
   

  

 We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.
   

  

 You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.
* Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.
* You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.
* Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.
* Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
* Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.
* Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.
* Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
* Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
* You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.
* You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
* You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.
* You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
* This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.


 The United States base range for this position is $281,196 – $401,709 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
   

  

 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know – we’re here to support you in any way we can.

description:

Här arbetar vi i innovativa, högteknologiska miljöer där vi utvecklar och tillverkar biologiska läkemedel som förändrar liv. Vardagen präglas av stark laganda, coachande ledarskap och nyfikenhet.  Din roll
   

  

 Som automationsingenjör med inriktning Vision & Product Security arbetar du med implementering, förvaltning och support av serialiserings- och aggregeringssystem, med fokus på plattformar som MTPCE och Systech. * Arbeta med visionsinspektioner, närvarokontroller och OCV-inspektioner för att säkerställa produktkvalitet, dataintegritet, spårbarhet och regelefterlevnad.

* Ansvara för leverantörskontakter och teknisk uppföljning av utrustning och system.
* Bistå i utredningar av störningar och avvikelser samt bidra till relevanta korrigerande och förebyggande åtgärder.

* Följa upp systemprestanda, återkommande störningar och förbättringsåtgärder med hjälp av relevanta data och nyckeltal.


 Arbetet innebär täta kontakter och nära samarbete med hela produktionsflödet samt med kvalitetssäkring, processteknik, IT/OT, underhåll, projektorganisationer och globala funktioner inom AstraZeneca.

* Kunskap om GMP och kvalitetssystem.

description:

 Vi söker nu en
 **Senior Cyber Vault Specialist** 
 till ett långsiktigt uppdrag hos en av Sveriges största aktörer inom bank och finans.
   

  

 Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill arbeta tekniskt och hands-on i en komplex IT-miljö med mycket höga krav på säkerhet, dataskydd och återställningsförmåga. Du kommer in i ett strategiskt viktigt initiativ där en ny Cyber Vault-miljö byggs upp från grunden och där du får möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar, arbetssätt och processer.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig
   

  

* Trygga anställningsvillkor och fast månadslön
* Ett långsiktigt uppdrag i en stor och komplex IT-miljö
* Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad teknik inom Cyber Vault och cyber recovery
* En roll där du får vara med och bygga upp en ny miljö från grunden
* Två valfria certifieringar per år
* Kompetensutveckling och möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas inom ditt specialistområde
* En närvarande konsultchef och individuell utvecklingsplan
* Ett stort nätverk av specialister inom drift, infrastruktur och säkerhet


 Din roll
   

  

 Som Senior Cyber Vault Specialist får du en central roll i etableringen och vidareutvecklingen av en ny Cyber Vault-miljö med fokus på säkerhet, dataskydd och cyberåterställning.
   

  

 Syftet med miljön är att säkerställa tillgång till en skyddad och verifierad återställningsmiljö, ett så kallat clean room, som kan användas för att återställa kritiska system och data efter en allvarlig cyberincident.
   

  

 Det här är framför allt en
 **teknisk och hands-on roll** 
 . Vi söker inte en renodlad arkitekt, utan dig som har senioriteten att förstå helheten och fatta tekniska beslut samtidigt som du själv vill arbeta med implementation, konfiguration, felsökning och uppbyggnad av miljön.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Bygga upp och implementera en ny Cyber Vault-miljö
* Arbeta hands-on med CyberSense och Cyber Recovery
* Implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar inom backup, recovery och dataskydd
* Arbeta med VMware, Commvault och NetApp
* Säkerställa att miljön möter höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och återställningsbarhet
* Delta i tester och verifiering av organisationens återställningsförmåga
* Arbeta med etablering och utveckling av clean room-lösningar
* Felsöka och lösa komplexa tekniska problem
* Bidra till utveckling av tekniska arbetssätt, processer och rutiner
* Samverka nära specialister inom VMware, storage, backup, infrastruktur och IT-säkerhet
* Dela teknisk kunskap och bidra till kompetensutvecklingen inom teamet
* Följa utvecklingen inom Cyber Vault, cyber recovery och dataskydd


 Vi söker dig som
   

  

 Har flera års erfarenhet inom infrastruktur, backup, storage och dataskydd och som har byggt upp en djup specialistkompetens inom Cyber Vault och cyber recovery.
   

  

 För den här rollen är det avgörande att du har
 **praktisk och djup erfarenhet av CyberSense och Cyber Recovery** 
 .
   

  

 Det räcker alltså inte att du har kommit i kontakt med teknikerna eller arbetat i en redan etablerad miljö. Vi söker dig som tidigare har varit delaktig i att
 **bygga upp och implementera större Cyber Vault- eller cyber recovery-miljöer** 
 och som är trygg med att självständigt arbeta hands-on med tekniken.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
   

  

* CyberSense
* Cyber Recovery / Cyber Vault
* Commvault
* NetApp
* VMware
* Backup och recovery
* Storage
* Dataskydd
* Clean room-miljöer
* Infrastruktur- och plattformssäkerhet
* Verksamhetskritiska IT-miljöer


 Du behöver inte vara arkitekt. Det viktiga är att du är en
 **senior teknisk specialist** 
 som både förstår hur lösningen hänger ihop och själv kan bygga, konfigurera, implementera och felsöka den.
   

  

 Om dig
   

  

 Du är tekniskt driven och tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet. Du trivs bäst nära tekniken och är van att självständigt ta ansvar för komplexa tekniska frågor.
   

  

 Eftersom området är under uppbyggnad behöver du också vara bekväm med att alla processer och lösningar inte redan är färdiga. Du tycker snarare att det är motiverande att få vara med från början, testa lösningar, identifiera förbättringar och bidra till hur miljön ska utformas framåt.
   

  

 Vi tror också att du:
   

  

* Är självgående och trygg i din tekniska kompetens
* Har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt
* Trivs med komplex teknisk problemlösning
* Är kommunikativ och tycker om att samarbeta med andra specialister
* Kan förklara tekniska frågeställningar på ett tydligt sätt
* Delar gärna med dig av din kunskap
* Är nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt specialistområde


 Mer om Nexer Infrastructure
   

  

 Nexer Infrastructure, tidigare Sigma IT Tech, startade sin verksamhet 2018 och är specialister på kompetens inom drift, support och infrastruktur.
   

  

 Vi hjälper organisationer att utveckla och framtidssäkra sina IT-miljöer genom våra konsulter och arbetar med välkända kunder inom både privat och offentlig sektor.
   

  

 Som konsult hos oss får du en trygg anställning samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utvecklas genom komplexa och långsiktiga kunduppdrag. Vi lägger stor vikt vid din fortsatta utveckling och arbetar tillsammans med dig för att hitta uppdrag och kompetensutveckling som ligger i linje med vart du vill ta nästa steg i din karriär.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.
   

  

 För den här rollen kommer vi lägga stor vikt vid din praktiska erfarenhet av
 **CyberSense, Cyber Recovery och uppbyggnad av större Cyber Vault-miljöer** 
 , så beskriv gärna detta tydligt i din ansökan.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
   

  

 Har du frågor om rollen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare:
   

  

**Jenny Örvell**
 Nexer Infrastructure

Master's thesis: Does continuous use of AI-assisted development make subsequent AI-assisted development more costly or difficult?
   

  

 We are looking for a dedicated master’s student to join us in the Connected Intelligence Unit at RISE.
   

  

 The Connected Intelligence Unit is part of RISE Computer Science in Kista. The current research focus is on devising intelligent autonomous systems for controlling and allocating resources in future computer and communication networks. Among the group's key technologies are the Internet of Things (IoT) and Edge computing. The unit conducts projects together with industry and academic partners from Sweden and across the world.
   

  

**Background and Purpose**
 Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering to generate code, implement features, and support developers throughout the software lifecycle. However, their effectiveness may depend strongly on the structure and quality of the existing codebase. Code created with extensive AI assistance may also develop different structural characteristics than human-written code, potentially affecting future AI-assisted development.
   

  

 This raises an important question for the long-term use of AI in software engineering:
 **Does continuous use of AI-assisted development make subsequent AI-assisted development more costly or difficult?**
**Thesis Description**
 This thesis aims to investigate how the structure and development history of a software project affect the ability of LLMs to implement new features. You will select suitable open-source projects and recreate them using AI-based development tools, simulating projects built with extensive AI assistance.
   

  

 New features with clearly defined completion criteria will then be implemented using AI on both the original and AI-generated codebases. The process will be evaluated based on development time, token consumption, number of attempts, and successful completion. The results will help identify whether AI-generated code structures influence the efficiency of future AI-assisted software development.
   

  

**Terms:**
 Start Time: As soon as possible
   

  

 Scope: 30 hp
   

  

 Location: RISE Computer Science, Kista, Stockholm. Option to partially work remotely.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 We expect you to have a solid knowledge of machine learning theory, good programming skills (especially Python), and an interest in computer systems and solving complex problems. You are also currently enrolled in a masters programme.
   

  

**We are looking forward to receiving your application!**
 To know more, please contact the supervisor Mariano Scazzariello (mariano.scazzariello@ri.se). The thesis will be conducted together with the KTH Networked System Laboratory and KTH Machine-Intelligence for Networks and Distributed Systems Laboratory. Applications should include a brief personal letter, CV, recent grades, and a code excerpt. Candidates are encouraged to send in their application as soon as possible but at the latest by the 15th of October 2026. Suitable applicants will be interviewed as soon as applications are received.

title: Senior Game Designer | Candy Crush Saga
description:
**Craft:**
 Games Design & Production
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Are you a systems thinker and creative architect? Do you dream of crafting features that connect everything together: where player progress feels meaningful, social interactions spark joy, and every reward motivates another level?
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented and collaborative Senior Game Designer to join the Gameplay team in Candy Crush Saga, shaping the future of our metagame features and systems in one of the most successful live games in the world. You’ll bring deep systems thinking to the features behind progression, competitive events, and social loops that touch millions of players every day.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

 As a Senior Game Designer, you’ll design and optimize metagame features and systems, such as progression, competitive events, and social loops, that bring structure, meaning, and delight to the player journey and support the team’s key strategic bets. You’ll own these features and systems end to end, from strategic framing and prototyping through implementation, live release, and iteration, and you’ll be able to explain not just what a feature does but why its specific values, pacing, and reward structure are the right solution.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, engineers, and other game designers to define, prototype, and deliver features and systems that are easy to use, deeply satisfying, and seamlessly connected to the core game.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and evolve metagame features and systems, such as progression, competitive events, and social loops, that deepen engagement and reflect a strong understanding of player behavior and motivation.
* Own metagame features, systems, and strategic bets end-to-end, from concept and specification through implementation, live release, and iteration.
* Use quantitative and qualitative data and player insights to inform, balance, and tune features and systems against key metrics.
* Translate strategic goals, KPIs, and player insights into clear, structured, and actionable design documentation, explaining why specific values, triggers, and pacing are the right solution.
* Partner with live ops teams to design and optimize features that maximize live events’ impact and player retention.
* Collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams (product, UX, engineering, data) to deliver high-quality, fun, and impactful experiences.
* Work with fellow designers to ensure metagame features and systems integrate cohesively with core gameplay and the wider game ecosystem.
* Stay informed on F2P trends in monetization and player engagement, and share relevant insights with the team.
* Bring fresh thinking and genre-leading ideas to the Candy Crush metagame, staying ahead of trends in casual F2P design.


**Skills**
* Proven Experience in Live F2P Metagame Design (Required): You have hands-on experience designing and running live metagame features and systems, such as progression, achievements, or social mechanics, for casual mobile free-to-play games. You understand the rhythms of live content, player motivation, and what keeps players coming back day after day.
* Feature Ownership & Strategic Delivery: You’ve owned or significantly contributed to metagame features or systems that drove long-term engagement in live casual games, from strategic framing through live release and iteration.
* Systems & Economy Thinking: You understand how to design and balance interconnected features and systems, progression, rewards, pacing, and player motivation, and can reason about how a change in one system ripples through the wider economy and player behavior.
* Data-Driven & Insight-Led: You’re comfortable diving into quantitative and qualitative player data, identifying patterns, and turning insights into meaningful design improvements.
* Player-Centric Mindset: You design for joy and motivation, and you’re excited to test, learn, and iterate with real player feedback.
* Collaborative & Structured Communicator: You’re a clear communicator who builds alignment across disciplines and helps teams rally behind great ideas.
* Craft Leadership & Mentorship: You share learnings with other designers, mentor less experienced colleagues, and help raise the bar for metagame design across the team.


* Experience working on match-3, merge, or social mobile games with large, active live playerbases.
* Experience designing progression systems, achievements, seasonal structures, or social gameplay loops at scale.
* Familiarity with economy balancing, live ops systems, or content pipelines.
* Knowledge of match-3 puzzle mechanics and how core gameplay systems (levels, boosters, board mechanics) connect to metagame and live features.


**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Senior Systemutvecklare
description:

 Till Polismyndigheten söker vi en senior systemutvecklare inom sektionen Persondokument och gruppen Elektronisk Legitimering som kommer att arbeta med utveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning av system och tjänster inom området identitetshantering, bland annat lösningar kopplade till PID (Personal Identification Data) och LPID (Legal Personal Identification Data). Rollen bidrar till att utveckla tekniska förutsättningar för den europeiska digitala identitetsplånboken och till att skapa säkra, robusta och skalbara lösningar med tydligt verksamhetsvärde.
   

  

 Konsulten ansvarar för att analysera och tolka verksamhets- och systemkrav samt omsätta dessa till hållbara och kvalitetssäkrade tekniska lösningar och programkod. Arbetet omfattar hela systemens livscykel, från design och implementation till test, driftsättning, felsökning, felrättning och vidareutveckling.
   

  

 I rollen ingår att självständigt föreslå tekniska lösningar, bidra till tekniska vägval och vid behov ta ansvar för ett större tekniskt område. Konsulten förväntas aktivt identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter i system, arkitektur och kodbas samt bidra till långsiktigt hållbara lösningar. Arbetet bedrivs med moderna tekniker och utvecklingsmetoder, såsom exempelvis mikrotjänstarkitektur, containerlösningar och automatiserade bygg- och distributionsprocesser.
   

  

 Konsulten kommer att arbeta i ett agilt utvecklingsteam inom Elektronisk Legitimering och samarbeta nära andra utvecklare, uppdragsledning och verksamhetsrepresentanter. Rollen innebär att bidra till teamets gemensamma mål och leveranser samt att ta ett stort ansvar för planering och genomförande av tilldelade arbetsuppgifter.

 Rollen omfattar utveckling och implementation samt systemförvaltning, felsökning, felrättning, förbättringsarbete och teknisk problemlösning. Konsulten förväntas att genom hela uppdraget bidra med sin seniora kompetens, initiativ och tekniska förståelse för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i teamets leveranser.

* Konsulten ska ha minst 3 års erfarenhet av Spring Boot och relaterade ramverk.
* Konsulten ska ha minst 2 års erfarenhet av mikrotjänstarkitektur.
* Konsulten ska ha minst 2 års erfarenhet av att implementera säkerhetslösningar tidigare baserat på OIDC/OAuth2.
* Konsulten ska ha minst 3 års erfarenhet av CI/CD på Jenkins, till exempel med verktyg/plattformar såsom Bitbucket och Openshift eller motsvarande.
* Konsulten ska ha goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.
* Konsulten ska ha svenskt medborgarskap.

* Konsulten bör ha god erfarenhet av att arbeta med elektroniska attributsintyg.
* Konsulten bör ha god erfarenhet av att implementera integrationer mot HSM:er eller motsvarande krypteringslösning.

* Dokumentera tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt
* Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra till en mer effektiv och stabil IT-miljö
* Samarbeta med interna team, andra tekniska specialister och externa leverantörer

 Har erfarenhet av systemadministration, drift, teknisk support, systemförvaltning eller en liknande teknisk roll och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta hands-on i IT-miljöer.
   

  

 Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. För oss är det viktigare att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är nyfiken och har förmågan att självständigt felsöka och sätta dig in i nya system och tekniker.

* SQL och databashantering

* Drift och övervakning

 Om dig
   

  

 Vi tror att du är en person som tycker om att lösa problem och som inte ger upp när svaret inte är uppenbart från början. Du är analytisk och strukturerad samtidigt som du är nyfiken och gärna testar dig fram för att förstå hur olika delar av en miljö hänger ihop.
   

  

 Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och driver dem framåt självständigt, men trivs samtidigt med att samarbeta och dela kunskap med andra.
   

  

 Eftersom rollen innebär kontakt med både tekniska kollegor, verksamheten och externa leverantörer är det också viktigt att du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta.
   

  

 Framför allt söker vi dig som
 **gillar teknik på riktigt**

 Mer om Nexer Infrastructure
   

  

 Nexer Infrastructure, tidigare Sigma IT Tech, startade sin verksamhet 2018 och är specialister på kompetens inom drift, support och infrastruktur.
   

  

 Vi hjälper organisationer att utveckla och framtidssäkra sina IT-miljöer genom våra konsulter och arbetar med välkända kunder inom både privat och offentlig sektor.

 Ansökan

 Vi ser fram emot att höra mer om dig och vad du vill göra härnäst!

**Jenny Örvell**
 Nexer Infrastructure

**Vem Vi Söker**

title: Cybersäkerhetsexpert – RISE CSDI
description:
*Cybersäkerhet är inte längre en fråga bara för IT-avdelningar – det är en grundläggande samhällsfråga. På RISE CSDI arbetar vi med att stärka Sveriges motståndskraft mot digitala hot, genom att kombinera djup teknisk expertis med en förmåga att översätta komplex kunskap till förståelse och handling. Vi söker nu en cybersäkerhetsexpert som vill göra båda delarna – stärka vårt team inifrån och arbeta direkt med de organisationer vi är till för.*
**Om RISE CSDI**
 RISE CSDI – Center for Security Design and Innovation – samlar expertis inom säkerhetsdesign, transformationsledarskap, innovationshantering och tillämpad forskning i säkerhetskritiska situationer. Vi kombinerar vetenskapligt grundade metoder med praktisk tillämpning i offentlig sektor, näringsliv och civilsamhälle, och bidrar till att stärka Sveriges förmåga att möta komplexa samhällshot.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Rollen som cybersäkerhetsexpert på RISE CSDI har en tydlig dubbel inriktning. Å ena sidan bidrar du till att höja den samlade cybersäkerhetsförmågan i det närmaste teamet – genom att dela kunskap, introducera nya verktyg och metoder samt hjälpa organisationen att hålla sig i framkant. Å andra sidan arbetar du direkt med våra partners och kunder – myndigheter, kommuner och organisationer i totalförsvarsekosystemet – för att hjälpa dem att förstå och hantera sina cybersäkerhetsutmaningar.
   

  

 Du är lika bekväm med teknisk djupdykning som med att förklara hotbilder och risker för en ledningsgrupp utan IT-bakgrund. Du följer nyfiken med i hur ny teknik – inte minst AI och automatisering – förändrar både hotlandskapet och möjligheterna för stärkt säkerhet.
   

  

 Befattningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass, vilket innebär att säkerhetsprövning kommer ske innan anställning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Genomföra riskbedömningar, säkerhetsanalyser och rådgivning åt kunder och partners inom offentlig och privat sektor
* Bidra till att bygga och stärka cybersäkerhetsförmågan internt på RISE CSDI, bland annat genom kunskapsdelning, utbildning och metodutveckling
* Kommunicera komplexa tekniska hot och säkerhetskontexter till icke-tekniska beslutsfattare och verksamhetsledare
* Följa och implementera ny teknik – särskilt AI-drivna verktyg och automatiseringslösningar inom säkerhetsarbete
* Delta i eller leda uppdrag inom ramen för Sveriges totalförsvar, inklusive samverkan med myndigheter och kommuner
* Bidra till RISE CSDI:s arbete med omvärldsbevakning och hålla teamet uppdaterat om aktuella hot, sårbarheter och trender


**Vi erbjuder**
* En roll i skärningspunkten mellan teknisk spetskompetens och samhällsnytta
* Tillgång till RISE:s breda nätverk av forskare, experter och samarbetspartners
* Möjlighet att arbeta i och med Sveriges mest avancerade testmiljöer för cybersäkerhet, inklusive vår Cyber Range
* Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling i en snabbt föränderlig och tekniktung miljö
* En inkluderande organisationskultur med starkt fokus på samarbete och delade mål
* Flexibla arbetsformer och konkurrenskraftiga anställningsvillkor


**Vem är du?**
 Du har en solid teknisk grund inom cybersäkerhet och har fått din erfarenhet från praktiskt arbete i komplexa miljöer. Du kombinerar djup teknisk förståelse med en påtaglig förmåga att kommunicera – du är lika väl hemma i ett tekniskt forum som framför en styrelse eller kommunledning.
   

  

 Krav:
   

  

* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av cybersäkerhetsarbete inom riskhantering, sårbarhetsanalys, incidenthantering eller säkerhetsarkitektur
* Förmåga att förklara tekniska säkerhetsfrågor på ett begripligt sätt för målgrupper utan teknisk bakgrund
* Nyfikenhet och aktivt intresse för ny teknik, särskilt AI och automatisering inom säkerhetsområdet
* Förmåga att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och behålla helhetsperspektivet i komplexa samverkansmiljöer
* Obehindrad i svenska och engelska, både skrift och tal


 Meriterande:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med eller agera rådgivare åt myndigheter, kommuner eller annan offentlig verksamhet i cybersäkerhetsfrågor
* Kännedom om regulatoriska ramverk som NIS2, ISO 27001, DORA eller MSB:s föreskrifter
* Erfarenhet av cybersäkerhet i totalförsvarskontext, kritisk infrastruktur eller säkerhetsklassad miljö
* Relevanta certifieringar, exempelvis CISSP, CISM, CEH eller likvärdigt
* Erfarenhet av SOC-arbete, hotintelligens eller säkerhetsautomatisering (SOAR)


 Personliga egenskaper:
   

  

 Du är en person som engageras av att göra säkerhet begriplig – inte bara tekniskt robust. Du ser det som din uppgift att bygga förtroende, sprida kunskap och göra andra organisationer stärkta, inte bara granskade. Du är nyfiken på hur AI och automatisering förändrar hotbilden och ser dessa tekniker som verktyg du vill behärska, inte hot du ska varna för.
   

  

 Du trivs med en roll som innebär både internt kunskapsarbete och externt kundmöte. Du är lika engagerad när du hjälper en kollega förstå en sårbarhet som när du står inför en ny kund och förklarar varför cybersäkerhet är en ledningsförmåga – inte bara en teknisk fråga.
   

  

**Är vi rätt för varandra?**
 Inom RISE gillar vi olikheter, och vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till en innovativ miljö där vi tillsammans kan utmana gränser och utveckla ny kunskap och nya färdigheter för framtiden. Vi kan inte lova dig ett lätt jobb, men vad vi kan lova är en spännande resa där vi tillsammans med engagerade och talangfulla kollegor kommer att bidra till en hållbar framtid och att ligga i framkant i den globala konkurrensen. Vill du vara med?
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Låter detta spännande och du vill veta mer så är du välkommen att kontakta Erik Bakkman, Enhetschef Säkerhetsdesign och Innovation, på erik.bakkman@ri.se. Sista ansökningsdag är den 25:e september. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under och efter ansökningsperioden. Sök utan personligt brev.
   

  

 Våra fackliga representanter är Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010 228 41 22 och Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-5165161.

title: Vice President, R&D
description:
*You'll own the technology direction for the platforms our 200+ utility customers run their business on. You'll lead managers, not just individual contributors, through a shift to AI-powered development. And you'll do it with real ownership from day one. This is your next move as Vice President, R&D at EG.*
**As Part of the department**
 Leading R&D for the Software Utility Companies Run On Zynergy and Xellent are EG's core software platforms for Utility, relied on by more than 200 customers across the Nordics every day. As Vice President, R&D, you'll lead the shift toward AI and automated development, and set the technology strategy that keeps both platforms reliable as electrification, flexibility markets and new regulation reshape the sector.
   

  

 You'll lead an international R&D organisation of around 120 people across Denmark, Sweden, Poland and India, with 5 direct reports. You'll report to Bjarki Björnsson, Senior Vice President for Utility, and join the Utility management team. The role is based in Stockholm.
   

  

**Your Role: Own the Technology Direction, End to End**
*Real ownership of an international development organisation, a genuine AI agenda with direct customer impact, and a platform for your next move in EG's leadership team.*
 The R&D organisation is yours to lead. You own development strategy, architecture, delivery and quality across the Utility portfolio, working closely with Product Management, Customer Support and Professional Services. You'll also set the AI agenda for Utility and share practice with R&D leaders across EG.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* International development organisation — lead and grow a distributed team across the Nordics and Mangalore, building one culture with strong local leadership and a deliberate onshore/offshore balance.
* AI in our products and how we build them — set the AI agenda for Utility end to end, and raise engineering productivity through AI-assisted development, automated testing and modern tooling.
* Technology and architecture — own the target architecture and modernisation roadmap for Zynergy and Xellent, balancing new capability, technical debt and long product lifecycles.
* Delivery, quality and commercial ownership — own release predictability and compliance and manage the R&D budget with a commercial mindset.
* Talent and customer proximity — attract, develop and retain leaders, and stay close to our 200+ customers to turn their reality into clear priorities.


**Your Profile: Technical Depth, Commercial Judgement, Real Leadership**
 Strategic thinking comes naturally, paired with the willingness to stay close to the technology, the teams and the customers. Transformation motivates you, and you know how to lead change across cultures, locations and time zones. The big picture stays in view, without losing focus on what matters most. Structure, development standards and continuous improvement matter to you, and you work closely with Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success and Sales — sharing practice with R&D leaders across EG along the way.
   

  

 Your background can vary, but to thrive in this role, you:
   

  

* Have proven experience leading R&D or engineering organisations at scale in an international software or SaaS company, including distributed teams.
* Bring strong technology judgement across cloud, data, architecture and the modernisation of established products.
* Have a practical, hands-on view of AI in a product context — from data foundation and governance to what turns into real customer value in production.
* Have a performance mindset grounded in evidence, with strong execution and a bias for action.
* Build trust as a leader, develop other leaders, and sustain motivation through change.
* Are curious, ambitious, and eager to grow in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant master's degree in engineering, computer science or similar.


**What's in it for You?**
 At EG, you will be trusted to set direction, drive change and take responsibility from day one. As part of our leadership team, you will have the mandate to influence strategy and build high-performing teams, in a collaborative, international culture where ambition goes hand in hand with trust and personal growth.
   

  

* Meaningful impact — lead teams that solve real challenges and build software that makes a difference in society and business.
* Real ownership — take responsibility from day one, with the freedom to shape your role, influence strategy and drive change.
* Continuous growth — find the space, support and opportunities to grow and take on new challenges.
* Collaborative culture — join a global, ambitious leadership team rooted in Nordic values, where collaboration and trust help us succeed together.
* AI at the frontier — put AI to work across our products and how we build them, with direct visibility into what it means for more than 200 customers.


**Our Values**
* Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.


**We Look Forward to Hearing From You!**
 If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Bjarki Björnsson, SVP Utility, on +45 20 69 95 85. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially. Please submit your application through our recruitment system using the Apply button.
   

  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**
 Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.
   

  

 Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.
   

  

 Curious what it's really like to work at EG?
   

  

 Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Expansion
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for building client relationships with enterprise businesses within a specified region. People who excel at this job have the ability to prospect, develop, and close business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements. The Enterprise AE's must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with clients and support new customers through our on-boarding process.
   

  

 This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects at a very exciting time for the company. Snowflake is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused company in a large and growing market. If you are an energetic, self-managed professional with experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:**
* Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.
* Develop marketing plans with the marketing team to drive revenue growth.
* Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace.
* Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams.
* Arrange and conduct initial Executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings.
* Sales process management and opportunity closure.
* Ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and drive additional revenue streams.
* Be familiar with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.


**OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:**
* 8+ years of field sales experience preferred with an emphasis on data or cloud related technology.
* 5+ year’s experience focussed on generating new business within Enterprise accounts.
* Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.
* Experience hitting quota of $1M+ of ARR per year and experience on averaging 8+ face to face meetings per week.
* A track record of success in driving consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.
* Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.
* Pro-active, independent thinker with high energy and a positive attitude.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to thrive in fast-paced startup environment.
* Executive level relationship management.
* Ability to understand the "bigger picture" and the business drivers around IT.
* BA/BS required.


**BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:**
* Industry specific experience - Telco & Hospitality are highly advantageous.
* Experience implementing MEDDPICC.
* Experience selling software or cloud based applications to the Enterprise is desired.


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?

title: Data Center Security Specialist
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
   

  

 We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Our Global Physical Security and Data Centre Operations teams are responsible for protecting CoreWeave’s personnel, infrastructure, and intellectual property across our international facilities. This team implements and enforces strict physical security standards, managing facility access, vendor relations, and compliance to safeguard our high-performance cloud infrastructure.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Center Security Specialist, you will manage day-to-day physical security operations, facility access policies, and audit procedures across CoreWeave’s data centre spaces in accordance with the principle of least privilege. You will act as the primary security liaison with colocation partners, conduct regular site inspections, produce detailed compliance reports, and support incident investigations when required. Additionally, you will design and deliver security training programmes for employees, visitors, and contractors while collaborating directly with clients to ensure our security practices align with their specific expectations. This role requires up to 20% travel across Europe to conduct security oversight and training sessions.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* 2–5+ years of experience in data centre security, or 5+ years in a broader physical security-related role (including relevant military, police, or public safety experience).
* In-depth knowledge of physical security principles, including access control administration, incident response, and security auditing.
* Strong written, analytical, and organizational discipline, with the ability to work autonomously and produce comprehensive audit documentation.
* Comfortable utilizing Mac, Windows, and Google Workspace applications.
* Ability to travel up to 20% across EU member states without requiring additional visas or work permits.


**Preferred**
* Certifications in enterprise physical security systems (e.g., Genetec, Axis).
* Recognized professional security certifications (e.g., PSP, CPP, CPTED).
* IT or computer networking experience.
* Background in security programme design, project management, or technical team mentorship.


**Wondering if you're a good fit?**
 We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring diversified experiences to our teams—even if you do not match 100% of the listed criteria.
   

  

* You love to: Implement robust physical security controls, conduct site audits, and deliver engaging security training.
* You're curious about: Emerging physical security technologies, colocation risk management, and international facility standards.
* You're an expert in: Access control management, site inspections, security compliance, and stakeholder liaison.

* Be Curious at Your Core
* Act Like an Owner
* Empower Employees
* Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
* Achieve More Together


 We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take-off, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
**Vill du säkerställa nästa generations ledningssystem för Försvarsmakten?**
 MilDef söker nu en
 **Quality Assurance Manager** 
 till kontoret i Rosersberg.
   

  

 Hos oss får du en central roll i utvecklingen av avancerade IT- och ledningssystem för Försvarsmakten, NATO och dess allierade. Du blir en del av vårt växande OneCIS-program och arbetar nära programledning, systems engineering, verifiering och kvalitet för att säkerställa att våra system håller rätt kvalitet och mognad inför viktiga beslut och leveranser.
   

  

**Din nya utmaning**
 Som Quality Assurance Manager ansvarar du för den oberoende kvalitetssäkringen av våra systemlösningar genom hela utvecklingslivscykeln.
   

  

 Du följer upp systemets mognad, säkerställer att relevanta underlag finns tillgängliga och bidrar med objektiva bedömningar inför viktiga beslutspunkter. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med flera tekniska discipliner samtidigt som du fungerar som en självständig och oberoende funktion inom programmet.
   

  

 Du blir en del av MilDefs kvalitetsorganisation tillsammans med funktioner som Quality Assurance, Project Quality, Configuration Management och QHSE.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* Säkerställa systemets kvalitet och mognad genom utvecklings- och releaseprocessen
* Delta i granskningar, beslutspunkter och kvalitetsbedömningar
* Följa upp krav, verifiering, testresultat och leveransstatus
* Identifiera och hantera kvalitetsrelaterade risker
* Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt inom kvalitetssäkring och systemutveckling
* Stödja programledning och projektorganisation med beslutsunderlag


**Vi söker dig**
 Som har flera års erfarenhet inom systemutveckling, kvalitetssäkring, verifiering eller systems engineering och trivs med att arbeta i komplexa tekniska miljöer.
   

  

 Du har ett analytiskt och strukturerat arbetssätt och är skicklig på att skapa ordning och tydlighet i komplex information. Du är van vid att samarbeta tvärfunktionellt och känner dig bekväm i dialog med såväl tekniska specialister som beslutsfattare och ledning.
   

  

 Som person är du självständig och trygg i dina bedömningar samtidigt som du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa goda samarbeten. Du drivs av att utveckla kvalitet, förbättra arbetssätt och bidra till långsiktigt hållbara resultat.
   

  

 Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
   

  

**Vi tror att du har:**
* Flera års erfarenhet från systemutveckling, systems engineering, verifiering, kvalitetssäkring eller teknisk programledning
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa system
* Erfarenhet av tekniska granskningar, mognadsbedömningar eller beslutsunderlag för större projekt eller program
* God förståelse för kravhantering, verifiering, konfigurationsstyrning och systemlivscykler
* Förmåga att se helheten och väga tekniska, kvalitetsmässiga och affärsmässiga aspekter mot varandra


**Vi tror att du är:**
* Analytisk och strukturerad
* Självständig och trygg i dina bedömningar
* Kommunikativ och samarbetsorienterad
* Driven av att förbättra kvalitet, arbetssätt och resultat


**Meriterande om du har**
* Erfarenhet från försvars-, säkerhets- eller annan reglerad verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av systems engineering, verifiering eller kravhantering
* Erfarenhet av kvalitetsarbete inom komplexa tekniska system
* Kunskap om relevanta standarder och utvecklingsprocesser


**Lär känna oss**
 På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ, som wellness-aktiviteter.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com
   

  

 För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta Alexander Sund, Head of Quality Assurance.
   

  

**Viktig information**
 Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.
   

  

 På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.
   

  

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***
*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*

title: Client Partner
description:

 Drive Business Growth
   

  

* Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve revenue growth targets across DXC’s portfolio of services and solutions.
* Identify, originate, and develop new business opportunities within existing client organizations.
* Lead renewal and retention strategies to protect and expand current revenue streams.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Syntrace builds conversational knowledge for institutional investors. We capture, organize and synthesize private conversations into source-backed knowledge a firm can build on.
 



  





 We are now hiring a Senior Product Manager, based in Stockholm.
 



  





 Our users trust us with the most sensitive conversations they have. That makes security part of the product, not a feature on top of it.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




  




* Lead discovery with pilot customers, and turn what you hear into clear problems, priorities and specifications.
* Define what quality means for our users, and work with our AI team to measure it.
* Make pragmatic trade-offs between user value, commercial impact and security, knowing when a simple change is enough and when a deeper capability is needed.
* Communicate product strategy, results and trade-offs clearly to the team, customers and other stakeholders.



  





**What you bring:** 




  




* Background or strong interest in product management.
* Big plus if you have experience building for demanding, regulated buyers.
* Strong judgment about what to build, what to leave and how to know the difference.

**What you get:** 




  




* A founding role with real ownership.
* A senior team that has scaled companies before.
* Direct access to some of the most demanding users in finance.



  





 To apply, send a short note to careers@syntrace.com about yourself.

title: Regional Sales Manager - Public Sector
description:

 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Regional Sales Manager (Senior Account Executive) Public sector is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
   

  

 You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. title: Product Cybersecurity Engineer

 Som Product Cybersecurity Engineer arbetar du i hjärtat av tekniskt komplexa produkter där mjukvara, hårdvara och säkerhet möts. Du är med genom hela produktlivscykeln, från koncept och arkitektur till lansering, vidareutveckling och avveckling. title: Software Engineer, Platform (Runtime)
description:
**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**About The Apps Platform**
 The Lovable Apps Platform is what makes those generated apps actually run in production. The moment a user hits deploy, the Apps Platform takes over — provisioning the database, handling user auth, storing files, serving the app over a custom domain, capturing logs, and metering usage. It's the full backend and hosting layer for every app built on Lovable, designed so creators never have to think about infrastructure to ship something real.
   

  

 The Apps Platform is growing fast, and we're investing heavily in each layer of the stack — building deeper ownership over the services that power our users' apps so we can move faster, scale better, and shape the product experience us and our users actually want.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for software engineers with a platform mindset to work on the app runtime, deployment pipeline, and the composable managed services we purchase and operate. Some foundational services we buy from 3p partners, others are not available for purchase and you would be the first in the world to build them at scale. You'll keep these services running reliably, manage vendor relationships and migrations, and ensure operational excellence across the stack.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the app hosting and deployment pipeline — the runtime that serves user applications in production
* Manage and operate composable managed services for storage, logging, workflows etc
* Build and maintain custom domains infrastructure, ensuring reliable SSL provisioning and DNS management at scale
* Drive vendor evaluation, onboarding, and migration as we continue decomposing our platform from a bundled BaaS to best-of-breed individual services
* Establish operational excellence practices: monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbooks, and capacity planning across all managed services


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience building and operating distributed systems
* Ideally 6+ years of experience in running and developing
* Strong background in platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure operations
* Deep understanding of multitenant app hosting infrastructure, container orchestration, or edge runtimes
* Vendor management experience: evaluating services, negotiating contracts, planning migrations, and holding vendors accountable for SLAs
* Operational mindset: you think in uptime, latency percentiles, cost-per-request, and blast radius


**Nice to Have**
* Experience building and operating massively multitenant control planes
* Experience operating Cloudflare Workers, Pages, R2, or D1 at scale
* Hands on experience contribution to cloud infrastructure or CNCF projects (kubernetes, worked, envoy)
* Familiarity with ClickHouse or other columnar databases for log analytics
* Experience with managed database services (such as Supabase, Neon, AWS Aurora, Google Cloud SQL etc)
* Cost optimization experience — you've driven meaningful infrastructure cost reduction


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
   

  

* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
