title: Senior Principal Runtime Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Runtime team at Sambanova is a seasoned engineering team with a proven track record of delivering cutting-edge system software solutions for AI and machine learning applications in the enterprise & commercial landscape.
   

  

 Runtime is responsible for the lowest levels of the SambaNova stack, efficiently interacting with the hardware to provide the best application performance and maximize hardware utilization. We handle all aspects of software infrastructure to enable higher level applications, including:
   

  

* High performance user libraries
* Operating System interface/integration
* Data model manipulation for scaling
* Networking/communication intra and inter node
* Orchestration of partitioned workloads
* Error monitoring and tools for system management and observability


 We build a high performance, distributed and scalable software execution environment for SambaNova DataScale & Cloud platforms to support data-flow applications such as ML training and inference and HPC applications.
   

  

 We are searching for a software engineer who will work on all parts of the runtime stacks, supporting AI, ML, and scientific applications in high-performance distributed systems. You will participate in building, testing and deploying next-generation high-performance compute systems for AI applications at scale. We expect the candidate to have a strong background in programming, building and testing software in distributed systems, performance tuning of large scale systems, and good teamwork and planning skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on design and implementation of new and enhanced features of the runtime stack to support high performance and scalable ML inference and training applications
* System software (drivers and kernel) support for the next generation silicon.
* Design user-space libraries for high performance and high utilization of HW resources.
* User-facing tools (analysis, job and HW management, profiling, debugging, etc) for Datascale systems.
* Collaborate with other teams including Hardware, ML Application, Compiler, DevOps.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent and with 3-5 years of industry experience
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python
* Experience with user space libraries, operating systems, and kernel drivers
* Experience working with highly concurrent and distributed systems, with a focus on performance and scalability


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with different types of fabrics, such as PCIe, Infiniband, and RoCE
* Experience with fast networking stacks, such as RDMA

title: Data Engineer
description:
HiQ växer inom data, AI och cloud - och vi letar nu efter Data Engineers som vill bygga moderna dataplattformar, skapa smarta dataflöden och göra det möjligt för våra kunder att fatta bättre beslut och utveckla nya tjänster.
   

  

 Som Data Engineer på HiQ kommer du att bygga och implementera skalbara dataplattformar i molnet, från datainhämtning och transformering till realtidsanalys och vidare till användning i analys, rapportering och AI. Du designar och optimerar datamodeller och dataflöden, inklusive streaminglösningar med till exempel Apache Kafka eller motsvarande, och du arbetar med robusta CI/CD processer samt IaC i moderna cloudmiljöer. Du blir en viktig del i hur våra kunder samlar, strukturerar och använder sin data för att skapa verkligt affärsvärde.
   

  

 Utöver detta kommer du att vara med i den AI satsning som HiQ gör, med möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arkitektur och arbetssätt för hur data blir navet i våra AI lösningar.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av data engineering och molnbaserade dataplattformar
* Erfarenhet av molnlösningar i Azure, AWS eller GCP
* Goda kunskaper i Python och SQL för att bygga, automatisera och optimera dataflöden
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datamodellering, prestandaoptimering och kvalitetssäkring av data

**Meriterande:**

**Varför HiQ**
 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklat världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. HiQ har alltid fokuserat på två saker: att ha kul på jobbet och att leverera lösningar utöver förväntningar, det är vad som driver oss framåt. Vi HiQare är stolta över att ha en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå våra gemensamma mål och strävar efter att hjälpa varandra att fortsätta växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du utöver chansen att utveckla din egen kompetens också möjlighet att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.
   

  

*I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå urvalsfrågor, intervjuer, tekniska tester, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och tillsammans forma framtidens dataintensiva och AI drivna lösningar. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!*

title: Account Director, Startups
description:

 OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.
   

  

**About The Role**
 OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our Startups Go To Market team. You will play a critical role in owning relationships with top startup customers and supporting them in building successfully on the OpenAI platform.
   

  

 We believe that many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications will be created by startups. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will support startups building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, and provide access to OpenAI teams and expertise to support their growth.

You’ll be responsible for serving as the primary relationship owner for a set of strategically important startup customers, as well as working across the OpenAI organization to help these startups accelerate their progress and be successful using our models. * Manage a portfolio of startups accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.
* Own a consumption revenue target.

* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.

* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.

title: Strategic Account Executive - Sweden - Industrials & Telecom
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
   

  

 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. * ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

* High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


 What we offer
   

  

* Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


 We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Sweden's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Industrials and Telecommunications. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swedish industrial and telecom organizations — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.
   

  

 In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Sweden, with a primary focus on Industrials and Telecommunications, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.
* Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for industrial and telecom organizations.

* Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Swedish industrials and telecom sectors, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.


**Requirements**
* 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.
* Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.
* Well-connected in the Swedish industrials and telecom landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.
* Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.
* Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Sweden, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.
* Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.
* Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.
* A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.
* Native or full professional proficiency in Swedish; strong English for internal collaboration.


**Location**
 This is an in-country role with a preference for a candidate based in Stockholm. You can work remotely or from our office in Stockholm.

 Vi ser att du har:

* Erfarenhet av systemadministration, användarstöd eller systemförvaltning.
* God förståelse för kommersiella processer – hur KAM arbetar samt ekonomiska samband och forecastingprocesser.

* God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

* Salesforce, SAP eller avancerad Excel.
* Prognoser, kundinvesteringar, lönsamhetsarbete eller kontrollprocesser såsom SOX och COA.
* Internationell kontext.

Du har ett starkt intresse för att förstå verksamheten bakom systemen och motiveras av att hitta förbättringar som skapar värde för användarna. Du bygger förtroende hos olika intressenter, kommunicerar tydligt och har förmågan att balansera affärsbehov, processer och systemkrav. Vi tror också att du är nyfiken, initiativrik och gillar att samarbeta med många olika funktioner för att skapa långsiktiga lösningar. God förmåga att planera och strukturera kommer att göra dig framgångsrik i rollen.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
At Ingrid, we're redefining how delivery works in ecommerce. Our platform helps retailers turn delivery into a competitive advantage, reducing checkout friction, increasing conversion, and building long term customer loyalty.
   

  

 As we scale across Europe, we're adding a new growth seat to our Nordics team. We're looking for a Senior Account Executive who can bring Ingrid to more ambitious retailers and help define how we sell into an increasingly sophisticated market.
   

  

**The role**
 As a Senior AE at Ingrid, you'll own the whole sales cycle for mid market and enterprise retailers, from prospecting and discovery through to closing and handover. This isn't a role where you simply work leads as they land in your inbox. You'll need to generate and shape your own pipeline.
   

  

 You'll sell in a challenger style, bringing retailers a point of view on their delivery and checkout experience rather than just responding to what they ask for. You'll need real fluency in the ecommerce landscape: how retailers think about platform migrations, where delivery and fulfilment fit into their broader tech stack, and how to translate that complexity into a simple, compelling business case.
   

  

 We're also looking for someone who works differently. AI is already part of how our best sellers prospect, prepare, and manage their day. We want someone who rethinks their own workflow with these tools rather than bolting them on.
   

  

 This is a role with high ownership, a clear path to target, and real impact on our growth in the region.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own and drive the whole sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, demo, business case, and close
* Build and manage a portfolio of target accounts, with real ownership over pipeline generation
* Own territory and account planning for your patch, deciding where to focus and why
* Engage decision makers using personalised outreach across multiple channels
* Run structured, challenger style sales processes using MEDDPICC and value based selling
* Build clear ROI cases and go live plans for customers
* Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in HubSpot

title: Global Maximo Product Owner
description:
Scania Industrial Maintenance AB is a technical production support company within Scania CV AB. We are responsible for production and facility maintenance within Scania and have approximately 1,200 employees in Södertälje, Oskarshamn and Luleå. Our operations are characterized by continuous development, high levels of expertise and close collaboration.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Global Product Owner for Maximo, you will play a key and strategic role in ensuring that Scania’s global Enterprise Asset Management solution develops in a direction that best supports the business.
   

  

 Maximo is used across Scania to support maintenance operations, including planning and execution of maintenance activities, spare parts management and other processes related to both production equipment and facility infrastructure.
   

  

 The application is used globally, and you will work with stakeholders representing different countries and business areas. You will be the person who brings together global business needs, prioritizes them and makes decisions on which improvements and developments should be pursued.
   

  

 You will work closely with the business, internal development resources and our external Maximo solution provider. While technical understanding is important, this is primarily a business-oriented Product Owner role. Your ability to understand maintenance operations, manage stakeholders and translate business needs into clear priorities will be key to your success.
   

  

**Your main responsibilities:**
 As Global Product Owner for Maximo, you will:
   

  

  

* Own and continuously develop the direction and priorities for the global Maximo solution.
* Gather, understand and prioritize maintenance-related needs from stakeholders across Scania.
* Make decisions on which improvements, developments and upgrades should be prioritized.
* Ensure that Maximo develops in line with the needs and strategic direction of the maintenance organization.
* Work closely with global process representatives and stakeholders from different countries.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements and priorities for development.
* Collaborate with internal application developers and the external Maximo solution provider.
* Challenge and evaluate proposed solutions to ensure they meet business needs and create value.
* Coordinate and align different stakeholder perspectives and ensure transparency around priorities and decisions.
* Drive continuous improvement of the application and the maintenance processes it supports.
* Represent the business in discussions concerning the future development of Maximo.
* Ensure that the application remains fit for purpose as Scania’s maintenance organization and ways of working evolve.


**Who You Are**
 We are looking for a business-oriented Product Owner with a strong understanding of maintenance operations and Enterprise Asset Management solutions.
   

  

 You have experience with:
   

  

  

* Enterprise Asset Management solutions, preferably IBM Maximo.
* Maintenance processes and operations.
* Business requirements and prioritization.
* Stakeholder management in a complex organization.
* Working with development teams and/or external suppliers.
* Driving improvements and translating business needs into digital solutions.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is also valuable, as there are similarities between these environments.


 Experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment and from a global organization is considered an advantage.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you:
   

  

  

* Have strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Are comfortable working with stakeholders from different countries and business areas.
* Can balance competing needs and make clear prioritization decisions.
* Are able to represent the business perspective while working closely with IT and technical teams.
* Have a good understanding of both business processes and supporting systems.
* Are structured and able to turn complex requirements into clear priorities and actions.
* Are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.
* Have the ability and willingness to learn and adopt Scania’s ways of working.


**Who We Are**
 At Scania Industrial Maintenance, we work to create the conditions for reliable, efficient and sustainable production through professional maintenance and technical expertise. Digitalization is an important part of this development, enabling us to improve our ways of working and strengthen maintenance processes across the organization.
   

  

 We strive for an inclusive work environment with engaged leaders and an open climate, where we continuously work towards a more gender-balanced workplace with diversity in focus. At Scania Industrial Maintenance, professionalism, collaboration and safety are central values.
   

  

 Here, you will have the opportunity to influence and contribute to Scania’s long-term development while continuing to grow both personally and professionally.
   

  

**What Scania Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and flexible workplace with hybrid working opportunities, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, Scania supports your career development both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to training at our health centre Gröndal or a wellness allowance, performance bonuses, flexible working hours where the business and role allow, and opportunities for a company car. Scania also organizes events for employees and their families, and residents of Stockholm have direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job Express buses.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV, and kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Please apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-22. Selection will take place continuously during the application period. Logic and personality tests may be used as part of our selection process, and a background check may be required for this position.
   

  

 We actively work with diversity and inclusion throughout the organization and welcome all applicants.
   

  

 If you have any questions or would like to know more, please contact: Group manager IT, jianing.zong@scania.com, 0700869191

description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to millions of people of people in their everyday lives.
   

  

 Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.
   

  

 In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.
   

  

 By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.
   

  

 Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.
   

  

 If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Engineer in our Global Data & BI team, you will build and operate the pipelines that power the Odevo Data Warehouse (ODW). Working within an established Microsoft Fabric architecture, you'll ingest data from the many source systems used across our operating companies, model it into trusted, reusable datasets, and keep it flowing reliably to the dashboards and data products our business depends on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines in Fabric Data Factory across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and file-based feeds, including incremental and change data capture patterns.
* Develop and test transformation models across the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers (medallion architecture), following the team's modelling standards and naming conventions.
* Model data for analytical consumption — dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, and handling multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-country data.
* Operate what you build: monitor pipeline health, investigate and fix failures, respond to source schema changes, and improve reliability and run cost.
* Implement data quality tests and validation rules in pipelines, working to the standards set by our Data Enablement squad.
* Prepare and document governed datasets for the Published layer, so that BI developers, semantic models and downstream applications can consume them with confidence.
* Work within our engineering workflow — version control and CI/CD in Azure DevOps, peer review, secrets management in Azure Key Vault, and clear documentation of pipelines and lineage.
* Work directly with BI developers and business stakeholders to understand what the data is for, and translate that into pipelines and models that answer the actual question.


**Who You Are**
 You're a pragmatic builder who gets things into production. You're comfortable with messy, undocumented source systems and enjoy the detective work of figuring out what the data actually means. You take ownership of the pipelines you build rather than handing them over, you ask what a dataset is for before you build it, and you can explain what you've done to someone who doesn't work in data. You want to work somewhere the data platform is still being built out, rather than somewhere it's already finished.
   

  

**Experience**
* 2–4 years' hands-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
* Strong SQL, and Python for data manipulation, automation and API-based ingestion.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Data Warehouse / Lakehouse, OneLake) — or with the Azure equivalents such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks, and the appetite to move onto Fabric quickly.
* Practical experience transformation framework and a solid grasp of modular, tested SQL modelling.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT and dimensional modelling.
* Comfortable working with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps.
* Awareness of data protection and security practice — GDPR, handling of personal data, role-based access — applied to the data you work with.
* Nice to have: experience integrating newly acquired businesses or consolidating data across multiple legal entities; exposure to Power BI as a consumer of your models.


**What Success Looks Like In Your First Six Months**
* You've independently onboarded a new source system into the Bronze and Silver layers, from first connection through to a tested, documented model.
* You're the go-to person for two or three pipelines, including keeping them running.
* You've built at least one Gold-layer dataset that a BI developer or stakeholder is actively using for reporting.
* You're contributing to code review and raising improvements to how the team works, not just consuming the standards.


**What We Offer**
* Professional growth - to work with the most talented developers in the industry.
* Modern technology - we invest in the latest technologies and tools and encourage our team members to share their ideas and take ownership of their work.
* Innovation - to work on exciting projects that push the boundaries of our industry and make a real impact.
* Commitment to quality - a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values profitable and long-term product development.
